subject: MAP alignment: contracting gates, redline cadence, and final evaluation timeline (Nimbus Labs)
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alex Torres <atorres@nimbuslabs.com>, Procurement Team <procure@nimbuslabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: contracting gates, redline cadence, and evaluation timeline (Nimbus)

Alex / Procurement team — thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, I wanted to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) so we have clarity on contracting milestones, redline expectations, and the final evaluation/close timeline. I attached a working MAP (nimbus_map_v0.3.xlsx) with suggested owners and dates.

High-level asks:
- Can procurement confirm the internal terms owner and preferred redline channel (DocuSign redlines vs. native redline in Google Docs)?
- Legal: we should agree an initial redline window (we suggest 3 business days for first pass).
- Evaluation: Nimbus has a 2-week POC window — confirm final acceptance criteria and SCC (service continuity) expectations.

Proposed contracting gates (each with owner):
1) Intake & open questions — owner: Alex Torres (Nimbus) / David (Redwood) — target: 2026-08-17
2) Terms alignment + first redline — owner: Nimbus Legal / Marissa Cole — target: 2026-08-20
3) Final commercial sheet + SOW signoff — owner: Alex / Neha Kapoor — target: 2026-08-25
4) Signatures & handoff to onboarding — owner: Procurement / Solutions — target: 2026-08-28

Attachments: nimbus_map_v0.3.xlsx (MAP draft), SOW-redline-guide.docx (Redline process primer).

If the owners above look right I will schedule a 30m alignment on 8/17 to walk through the MAP and finalize acceptance criteria.

Thanks,

—
David Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Torres <atorres@nimbuslabs.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@nimbuslabs.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: contracting gates, redline cadence, and evaluation timeline (Nimbus)

David — thanks for the structured plan, much appreciated. Quick answers from procurement:
- Primary terms owner: Sandra Liu (cc'd) — she will own legal intake and coordinate with our outside counsel.
- Preferred redline channel: our team prefers Google Docs for initial collaborative redlines, then a final PDF via DocuSign for signatures.
- POC acceptance: we expect feature acceptance + security checklist (SOC2 controls) to be met. I'll send a short checklist by EOD.

We can do the 8/17 alignment — please send a calendar invite. On dates, procurement would like the first redline window moved to 8/22 (to allow an internal review). If Redwood needs earlier, let us know tradeoffs.

Alex
VP, Product Operations | Nimbus Labs
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sandra Liu <sandra.liu@nimbuslabs.com>, Alex Torres <atorres@nimbuslabs.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: contracting gates, redline cadence, and evaluation timeline (Nimbus)

Hi Sandra / Alex — looping in our contracting playbook and a short redline checklist so expectations are aligned. Summary items below and attached: SOW-redline-guide.docx.

Redline process (recommended):
- Collaborative pass in Google Docs (track changes/comments) — target: 3 business days for initial redline from receipt. If Nimbus needs 5 business days we can be flexible; please flag which sections will need extended review (PII/data residency, indemnity, data retention).
- Legal-to-legal call if there are material policy changes (e.g., data residency / on-prem options) before final redline.
- Final commercial conformed document to be circulated for signature via DocuSign.

Milestone cadence we propose (updated per Nimbus request):
- 8/17: MAP walkthrough (30m) — David + Alex + Sandra + Karthik — objective: agree owners/acceptance criteria
- 8/22: Redwood to receive first collaborative redline (Google Doc) — owner: Nimbus Legal
- 8/25: Redwood responds with counter-redline and updated commercial sheet — owner: Marissa
- 8/28: Target for final signatures (contingent on no material policy changes)

Evidence/controls note: to expedite SOC2/security questions, please share the procurement questionnaire or the specific control rows you need validated. We can attach our SOC2 summary and evidence links to the MAP.

Attachments: SOW-redline-guide.docx (explains our preferred redline workflow), nimbus_map_v0.3.xlsx (updated with milestone owners).

Regards,

Marissa Cole
Head of Contracts | Redwood Inference
